newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Telepar dowgraded to sell.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Telepar dowgraded to sell.

text.p: -- Fator Securities said it downgraded Brazilian telecom firm Telepar to sell from hold.
-- It said Telepar's results for the first half showed a 131 percent rise in net income in real terms, totalling 67 million reais, year on year.
-- "However, this increase was lower than the average for the other companies we cover within the Telebras system whose net profits rose by between 170 percent and 200 percent," it added.
-- It also said it was revising down its net profit forecasts for the whole year to 131 million reais from 142 million reais.
-- Telepar preferred shares were flat at 486 reais at 1525 local/1825 GMT on the Sao Paulo bourse.
